notes.random: Each is compared with 200 random-entry runs at its own time in market: random intraday trades, never overlapping and closed by the session's last bar, with lengths drawn from that strategy's own trades and the same share of longs, paying the same costs.
notes.val: Not a clean test. These 2 were picked from the cb_nr_es_v3_15m finalists using their 2023–2024 results (Sharpe, beats-luck, overlap with each other) as well as 2018–2022, and the grid itself was chosen after reading round 1 on 2023–2024, so 2023–2024 is in-sample for the choice. It shows the strategies held up; it can't prove it. The untouched test is the 2025+ holdout tab.
notes.holdout: First NR-N look at the ES holdout. The only earlier NR-N access to ES 2025+ was the final-test of these same two frozen picks (plus one page-build attempt that crashed on a code error before producing results), so there's no selection among holdout results. The sibling BB/KC squeeze line, and the mean-reversion and noise-band families, were scored on ES 2025+ earlier, so the researcher has seen how that period treated them.
